Four independent, cohort-based courses, self-contained but designed to build on each other into a complete methods pathway. No prerequisite is mandatory, though taking them in order is recommended.

## Next cohort

Enrollment is open. Registration is per course; participants may register for a single course or for all four.

| Course | Focus | Dates |
|---|---|---|
| **BIOSTATR** | Applied Biostatistics with R | 07/09 &ndash; 20/09/2026 |
| **ML4HOR** | Machine Learning for Health Outcomes with R | 21/09 &ndash; 04/10/2026 |
| **SURV4CR** | Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R | 05/10 &ndash; 18/10/2026 |
| **METAR** | Conducting Meta-Analysis with R | 19/10 &ndash; 01/11/2026 |

## Catalogue

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

## BIOSTATR &ndash; Applied Biostatistics with R

Full analytical workflow for health research: study questions, data types, descriptive statistics, visualization, inference, regression, survival analysis, diagnostic accuracy, missing data, causal thinking, and reproducible reporting with Quarto. No statistics background required.

[Full training sheet &rarr;](biostatr.qmd)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

## ML4HOR &ndash; Machine Learning for Health Outcomes with R

Complete supervised learning workflow, plus clustering for patient phenotyping and subgroup discovery. Emphasis on validation, leakage prevention, calibration, interpretability, and clinical relevance.

[Full training sheet &rarr;](ml4hor.qmd)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

## SURV4CR &ndash; Survival Analysis for Clinical Research with R

Full time-to-event workflow: censoring, Kaplan-Meier, log-rank tests, Cox regression, proportional hazards diagnostics, competing risks, RMST, survival machine learning, and temporal phenotyping.

[Full training sheet &rarr;](surv4cr.qmd)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

## METAR &ndash; Conducting Meta-Analysis with R

Complete evidence-synthesis workflow: review question, extraction table, effect sizes, fixed- and random-effects models, heterogeneity, forest plots, moderators, publication bias, and certainty of evidence.

[Full training sheet &rarr;](metar.qmd)

:::

:::
<!-- end grid -->

## FAQ

**Can I take just one course?**
Yes, each course is self-contained and registered/paid separately.

**Do I need to know R already?**
No, not for **BIOSTATR**. The other courses recommend it as preparation but don't require it.

**What language is it taught in?**
French, with English for statistical and technical terms.

**How do I register?**
Email [elbadisyimad@gmail.com](mailto:elbadisyimad@gmail.com) with your name and chosen course(s).
